name: Deepavalli Arumuganainar
abstract_title: Quantum Energy Envelopes and the Persistence of the Information Vortex: A Theoretical Exploration of Life, Sleep, Death and Continuity
abstract: The information vortex theory proposes that abiogenesis involves not only the bio-molecular constituents of the prebiotic soup, but also the emergence of an information vortex within its quantum energy envelope. This vortex functions as a central processor and information storage system [1]. Signal processing within this vortex, in response to interactions with the environment, enables the evolution of basic physiological functions such as sensing, locomotion, nutrition, and reproduction [1,2].
affiliation: Saveetha Dental College and Hospitals, Saveetha University
field: Periodontology, bioinformation theory, quantum energy envelopes
notable: Developed Information Vortex Theory; published in Communicative & Integrative Biology
